metrics.label: Total population
metrics.caveats: American Community Survey 5-year estimate pooled over 2020-2024 (not a 2024 point estimate); sample-based, with a 90% margin of error. County totals are controlled to the official population estimates, so the ACS publishes no sampling margin of error for them (shown as 0).

metrics.label: Female population, all ages
metrics.caveats: American Community Survey 5-year estimate pooled over 2020-2024 (not a 2024 point estimate); sample-based, with a 90% margin of error.

metrics.label: Women aged 20-24
metrics.universe: Female residents aged 20 to 24, any marital status
metrics.definition: ACS B01001_032E + B01001_033E + B01001_034E (Female: 20 years; 21 years; 22 to 24 years).
metrics.method: Sum of published ACS age cells; margin of error sqrt(sum of squared cell MOEs), the Census Bureau's approximation.
metrics.caveats: American Community Survey 5-year estimate pooled over 2020-2024 (not a 2024 point estimate); sample-based, with a 90% margin of error. All women of that age, married or not.

metrics.universe: Female residents aged 25 to 29, any marital status
metrics.caveats: American Community Survey 5-year estimate pooled over 2020-2024 (not a 2024 point estimate); sample-based, with a 90% margin of error.

metrics.universe: Female residents aged 30 to 34, any marital status
metrics.caveats: American Community Survey 5-year estimate pooled over 2020-2024 (not a 2024 point estimate); sample-based, with a 90% margin of error.

metrics.label: Women aged 20-29
metrics.universe: Female residents aged 20 to 29, any marital status
metrics.method: Sum of published ACS age cells; approximate margin of error.
metrics.caveats: American Community Survey 5-year estimate pooled over 2020-2024 (not a 2024 point estimate); sample-based, with a 90% margin of error.

metrics.label: Never-married women aged 20-24
metrics.universe: Female residents aged 20 to 24 who have never married (population 15 years and over)
metrics.definition: ACS B12002 cell 'Female: Never married: 20 to 24 years', found by its published label.
metrics.method: Published ACS cell, located by label at build time.
metrics.caveats: American Community Survey 5-year estimate pooled over 2020-2024 (not a 2024 point estimate); sample-based, with a 90% margin of error. Never married is not the same as single: it includes people living with a partner and excludes the divorced and widowed. B12002 publishes 20-24 as one bin; no finer age split exists.

metrics.universe: Female residents aged 25 to 29 who have never married (population 15 years and over)
metrics.definition: ACS B12002 cell 'Female: Never married: 25 to 29 years', found by its published label.
metrics.method: Published ACS cell, located by label at build time.
metrics.caveats: American Community Survey 5-year estimate pooled over 2020-2024 (not a 2024 point estimate); sample-based, with a 90% margin of error. Never married is not the same as single: it includes people living with a partner and excludes the divorced and widowed. B12002 publishes 20-24 as one bin; no finer age split exists.

metrics.label: Never-married women aged 30-34
metrics.universe: Female residents aged 30 to 34 who have never married (population 15 years and over)
metrics.definition: ACS B12002 cell 'Female: Never married: 30 to 34 years', found by its published label.

metrics.caveats: American Community Survey 5-year estimate pooled over 2020-2024 (not a 2024 point estimate); sample-based, with a 90% margin of error. Never married is not the same as single: it includes people living with a partner and excludes the divorced and widowed. B12002 publishes 20-24 as one bin; no finer age split exists.

metrics.label: Never-married women aged 20-29
metrics.universe: Female residents aged 20 to 29 who have never married
metrics.definition: Sum of the B12002 never-married female cells for 20-24 and 25-29.
metrics.method: Sum of published ACS cells; approximate margin of error.
metrics.caveats: American Community Survey 5-year estimate pooled over 2020-2024 (not a 2024 point estimate); sample-based, with a 90% margin of error. Never married is not the same as single.

metrics.label: Share of women 20-29 who have never married
metrics.method: Ratio of ACS estimates; margin of error by the Census Bureau's formula for a derived proportion (approximate). The build checks that B01001 and B12002 give identical female 20-29 totals at every geography.
metrics.caveats: American Community Survey 5-year estimate pooled over 2020-2024 (not a 2024 point estimate); sample-based, with a 90% margin of error. Derived from two published tables.

metrics.label: Women aged 20-29 per 1,000 residents
metrics.method: Ratio of ACS estimates; approximate margin of error.
metrics.caveats: American Community Survey 5-year estimate pooled over 2020-2024 (not a 2024 point estimate); sample-based, with a 90% margin of error. A density, not a count: small counties can rank high.

metrics.label: Catholic adherents (all ages)
metrics.universe: Adherents of the Catholic Church, all ages, as reported to the 2020 U.S. Religion Census
metrics.definition: Group Detail workbook, sheet '2020 Group by County', Group Code 081 'Catholic Church', column Adherents.
metrics.caveats: 2020 U.S. Religion Census. Adherents are people of all ages the Catholic Church counts as members (including children); not Mass attendance, not women 20-29, and a 2020 count shown next to 2020-2024 ACS estimates. Connecticut's 2020 data are by its former counties and cannot be joined to the 2024 planning regions (flag geo_changed). Puerto Rico is not covered. A county with no Catholic Church row in the Group Detail file is shown as unavailable (not_published), not as zero.

metrics.label: Catholic congregations
metrics.universe: Catholic Church congregations (parishes and missions as reported)
metrics.definition: Group Detail workbook, '2020 Group by County', Group Code 081, column Congregations.
metrics.caveats: 2020 U.S. Religion Census. Adherents are people of all ages the Catholic Church counts as members (including children); not Mass attendance, not women 20-29, and a 2020 count shown next to 2020-2024 ACS estimates. Connecticut's 2020 data are by its former counties and cannot be joined to the 2024 planning regions (flag geo_changed). Puerto Rico is not covered. A county with no Catholic Church row in the Group Detail file is shown as unavailable (not_published), not as zero.

metrics.label: Catholic adherents per 1,000 residents (all ages)
metrics.method: Ratio; the denominator is the Religion Census's own '2020 Population' column (same year, same geography). Flagged denominator_all_ages.
metrics.caveats: 2020 U.S. Religion Census. Adherents are people of all ages the Catholic Church counts as members (including children); not Mass attendance, not women 20-29, and a 2020 count shown next to 2020-2024 ACS estimates. Connecticut's 2020 data are by its former counties and cannot be joined to the 2024 planning regions (flag geo_changed). Puerto Rico is not covered. A county with no Catholic Church row in the Group Detail file is shown as unavailable (not_published), not as zero.

metrics.label: Catholic congregations per 100,000 residents
metrics.method: Ratio against the Religion Census's own 2020 population column.
metrics.caveats: 2020 U.S. Religion Census. Adherents are people of all ages the Catholic Church counts as members (including children); not Mass attendance, not women 20-29, and a 2020 count shown next to 2020-2024 ACS estimates. Connecticut's 2020 data are by its former counties and cannot be joined to the 2024 planning regions (flag geo_changed). Puerto Rico is not covered. A county with no Catholic Church row in the Group Detail file is shown as unavailable (not_published), not as zero.

metrics.label: Republican share of the 2024 presidential vote
metrics.universe: Votes cast for president in the county, 2024
metrics.definition: Republican candidate votes / total presidential votes (MIT Election Lab county returns).
metrics.method: Not computed: the source file has not been downloaded.
metrics.caveats: Exploratory ecological proxy, untested against any individual-level outcome; off in the default weights. A county's vote says nothing about any individual.

metrics.label: Listed public Catholic young-adult venues
metrics.universe: Rows of communities.json whose location joins to the county
metrics.definition: Count of listed public venues (parish young-adult groups, campus ministries, etc.) in the county.
metrics.method: Count of rows; joined on geo_id or (county name, state).
metrics.caveats: A curated, incomplete listing of public organizations; a listing does not measure how many people attend. Flag unvalidated when any counted row was listed from search rather than checked on its official page. Diocese-wide offices without a county are counted only at state level.

metrics.label: Total fertility rate, 2023 (estimate)
metrics.universe: Women of reproductive age, whole country
metrics.definition: Average number of live births a woman would have over her reproductive life at the period's age-specific rates.
metrics.caveats: Childbearing behaviour in the period, not ideal or intended family size.

metrics.label: Total fertility rate, 2030 (UN projection)
metrics.universe: Women of reproductive age, whole country
metrics.caveats: Childbearing behaviour in the period, not ideal or intended family size. A model projection, not an observation.

metrics.label: Mean age at childbearing, 2023
metrics.definition: Mean age of mothers at the birth of their children (all birth orders).
metrics.caveats: All births, not first births.

metrics.label: Population, 1 July 2023
metrics.caveats: Published in thousands.

metrics.label: Female population, 1 July 2023
metrics.caveats: All ages, not the 20-29 target band.

metrics.label: Women 20-29, 2023
metrics.caveats: Not ingested: needs the WPP population-by-age file.

metrics.label: Crude marriage rate
metrics.definition: Marriages in the year per 1,000 average population.
metrics.caveats: Year differs by country; all-age denominator.

metrics.label: Mean age at first marriage, women
metrics.short: Women's mean age at first marriage
metrics.universe: Women marrying for the first time in the year
metrics.definition: Mean age of women at first marriage in the year.
metrics.caveats: Year differs by country.

metrics.label: Crude divorce rate
metrics.definition: Divorces in the year per 1,000 average population.
metrics.caveats: Divorces in the year per 1,000 average population (all ages). Not the probability that a marriage ends in divorce; depends on how many people are married, on law and on registration.
